request.authentication: Same trusted sales authentication/current origin policy as /sales/prepare-create; actor never supplied by request

types.expectedVersion: positive safe integer bounded by existing DB int version
types.businessType: SALE|RETURN|EXCHANGE, same explicit input semantics as existing SAVE
types.salespersonId: canonical UUID|null; existing frontend requirement unchanged

lineTypes.existingLineId: canonical owned current salesLine UUID|null; never an arbitrary proposed new native UUID
lineTypes.quantity: exact signed nonzero integer text; SALE positive only
lineTypes.dealPrice: exact nonnegative yuan text|null, existing pricing rule admits value
lineTypes.zeroConfirmed: boolean; not inferred from historical zero

settlementTypes.paymentMethodId: canonical UUID, actual enabled method of selected account

forbiddenInput: header number or new sales/document id

response.expectedVersion: same actual locked loaded header version; never incremented here
response.draft: existing SalesDraft wire format; bigint quantities/minor amounts are exact decimal strings via existing exactJson
response.ids: existing salesId/number preserved; server native ids only for NEW or explicitly replaced rows; no new salesId/number reservation
response.notAWriteToken: SAVE keeps its independent original requestKey and expectedVersion and rechecks actor/references/prices/CAS; prepare may be repeated and does not reserve business state

identityRules.existingPointers: Each nonnull pointer unique and belongs to this loaded document; sales lines must be currently active. Foreign/noncurrent/duplicate pointer rejected, no adoption/reactivation. Whole explicit proposal order retained; lineNo assigned1..N in that order, never grouped/sorted by SKU or UUID.
identityRules.sameSku: Keep exact existing line id, actual historical snapshot and stored referencePrice when existingLineId selects the same SKU. Recalculate quantity/deal/discount totals from explicit intent using its stored reference in discount mode; current minimum/reference availability and authorization still rechecked by current rules.
identityRules.newOrChangedSku: existingLineId=null creates a new line. If nonnull pointer selects a different SKU, allocate a new native line id and fetch current real MAIN snapshot/barcode/reference price; old id is omitted from incoming current lines, so existing SAVE mergeRetainedLines keeps it isCurrent=false with its old snapshot. This mapping is explicit in this preparation contract, never silent old-id snapshot overwrite.
identityRules.actualExistingWriteFacts: Current SAVE actually permits same-id sku/snapshot replacement; source does not impose a universal sameSKU identity invariant. The proposed preparation deliberately uses the already available omit+new-id path to retain the old row without changing SAVE or DDL. This is an explicit preparation choice for C freeze, not a claim of a pre-existing mandatory constraint.
identityRules.settlements: Same account+nonnull existingSettlementId retains id and actual stored method, which must equal explicit selected method; unknown stored method is not inferred. Changed account or existingSettlementId=null allocates a new native id and verifies selected actual account+method. Omitted old settlement follows existing SAVE removal behavior and old audit; no new physical-deletion rule.
identityRules.inputPreservation: Failure yields no partial draft; F1 must retain original local form and show conflict/reference error, no auto-reset, first-SKU selection or automatic submit.

authorizationAndReadSequence: Clone+closed parse and budgets before async; server-bound actor only.

Use one existing original sales UOW client; private server preparation nonce binds actor via existing getReceipt without writing receipt, never SAVE key. Load target once; authorize current actor against the stored document before disclosing version/state; require existing RUNTIME_LEDGER and DRAFT and exact expectedVersion. CUTOFF_HISTORY remains HISTORY-only.

Build proposed skeleton with original salesId and number, check both original-document SAVE access and proposed hall/warehouse/customer/staff/account scope with current native identity and existing reference policy. No made-up staff-hall or staff-role restriction.
Check pointer ownership/unique/current status. Obtain actual retained rows from loaded transaction, fresh native snapshots/facts only for new/replaced identities, no client snapshot authority.
Use existing gift/zero/minimum/pricing/sign/rounding/largest-remainder economics; RETURN/EXCHANGE remains independent signed rows and zero whole discount, settlement equality remains APPROVE-only.

Return bounded expectedVersion+draft; do not call putRuntimeSales/appendLedger/putBalance/appendAudit/insertReceipt/reserveRuntimeDocumentNumber/assertRuntimeDocumentNumber. SAVE still its existing complete write transaction.

readOnlyMeaning.businessEffects: Zero DML, zero receipt/audit/stock/document/number reservation. Restrict preparation-facing write methods to throw, and protocol trace must reject unexpected DML.
readOnlyMeaning.databaseTransaction: Existing sales UOW uses READ COMMITTED with advisory/row locks and reference FOR SHARE. This minimal reuse cannot be labeled PostgreSQL READ ONLY, which rejects those row locks. No attempt to rewrite SQL or strip locks. If C requires a physical READ ONLY repeatable snapshot, a separately reviewed read adapter is necessary; this proposal claims only zero business writes.
readOnlyMeaning.race: Read locks protect preparation snapshot until callback completes; later SAVE remains a fresh transaction and actual CAS/ref check. No cross-request grant cache.

errors.pointerErrors: Map foreign/noncurrent/duplicate proposal pointers to closed400 INVALID_HTTP_INPUT in this proposal; no SQL/private-provider error text

minimalNewChecks: Unchanged existing line uses original id/snapshot/reference despite changed current labels/reference; explicit edited price uses existing economics; no DML.
New and SKU-replaced rows use distinct server ids+actual snapshot; omitted old id stays unchanged before SAVE; same proposal row order preserved.
Foreign/noncurrent/duplicate pointers rejected; no fallback adoption.
Version/state/history/disabled actor, original or proposed hall/ref/current method mismatch reject and no DML/partial response.
Same-account stored unknown method not filled; changed account verifies current method and new id.
Signed RETURN/EXCHANGE, gift/zero/minimum/rounding and exact response/save budgets reuse existing economics with only new preparation path checks.
HTTP provider absent route404; exact closed wire/auth/origin/query/contenttype/body limits; no route enabled just by code presence.
limits: No new persisted fields/tables/constraints or SAVE write contract changes; reuse authorized existing omit+new-row path to retain old snapshot.
Zero business DML and no new document/number; READ COMMITTED locks are allowed, not PostgreSQL READ ONLY.
Absent provider stays unavailable; no runtime/actor/source grant from this DTO. Source checks precede actual host/client activation.
Additional actual write-contract or business difference must be reported before implementation.
